title: Settings
summary: Everything about the app itself, as a section with a menu of pages.

requirements.text: The main navigation has a Settings section, for signed-in users and guests alike.

Settings is a menu of pages: Account, Appearance, Code and diffs, GitHub sign-in (only in the app, which signs in itself), Keyboard shortcuts (only where there is a keyboard) and About. Each entry says what it is set to.
On a phone the menu is a screen and each page another, with back returning to the menu.
From 768 px wide the menu stays beside the open page, the first page is open to begin with, and picking another swaps it in place without adding a step to go back through.
The sidebar keeps marking Settings while one of its pages is open.
Signing out, the account's sign-in method and the API rate limit are under Account, and nowhere else: the profile carries no settings.
The theme is System, Light or Dark, each shown with a small picture of it. System follows the device, also when it changes while the app is open.

A switch between light and dark cross-fades the whole page in about 280 ms. Where the web view can't cross-fade, colors ease to their new values. With reduced motion asked for, it switches at once. The first paint is never animated.
On a desktop, Cmd or Ctrl+comma (and +4) opens Settings.
